fallback_positions: Penalty clause only if: (a) the burden of proof for the breach remains with the disclosing party, (b) the penalty amount is commercially reasonable and proportionate, and (c) the penalty is the sole monetary remedy
Penalty clause with a cap that is proportionate to the value of the engagement, and only for willful or grossly negligent breaches
red_line: Uncapped penalty, regarless of fault or penalty that is cumulative with unlimited damages
escalation_logic: Any contractual penalty clause should be reviewed by senior legal before acceptance
rationale: Prevents disproportionate financial exposure for breach
